claim_as_stated: NPact case study (2025-04-29) quotes SVCF's SVP Finance and states SVCF runs NetSuite with NPact's Fund Investment Tool for allocations/fees/rebalancing
exact_values_found: Quotes 'Sarah Valencia, Senior Vice President, Finance, Silicon Valley Community Foundation' (twice). 'a custom accounting application that would layer on top of NetSuite for completing its complex investment administrative fee, income allocation, spending policy, and investment rebalancing calculations'; implementation partner 'cautioned SVCF against building a custom finance application on top of NetSuite'; FIT 'designed specifically to integrate with leading fund accounting solutions like NetSuite'; SVCF 'partnered with NPact to co-develop FIT'; 'rebalancing can be done daily'; 'over 1,500 funds'
discrepancies: The story never says in so many words that SVCF's live FIT instance is integrated with NetSuite; NetSuite as SVCF's finance system is the clear implication (the custom app was to 'layer on top of NetSuite'). No CRM/portal vendor is named, so it gives no support for Salesforce at SVCF
contradictory_evidence: none found (no SVCF first-party or audit statement found either way)
interpretation_challenge: Vendor marketing with a commercial interest; a named SVCF officer is quoted, which raises reliability. Keep 'NetSuite + NPact FIT' at medium-high and Salesforce at SVCF at medium or lower

claim_as_stated: Voided/refunded grants itemised in 990 reconciliation: $16.0m, $16.6m, $11.2m (0.155%->0.073% of grants) for TY2021-2024 years as stated
validation_result: confirmed for the three values; series incomplete
discrepancies: Batch 28 marks TY2021 'n/s' (return not in harvest) although form990-returns-schedule-d-harvest-full.csv lists the amended TY2021 return (202430459349302913) and it carries $16,130,006 (0.141%). Year labels in batch 28 (TY2022-24 = FY2023-25) are correct; a reader taking the three values as TY2021-23 would be wrong

claim_as_stated: Fidelity Charitable iOS app: of 27 reviews since 2021, 20 describe defects incl. 10 login failures 2021-2023; DAFgiving360 and Vanguard Charitable have no standalone iOS app
validation_result: confirmed (20 depends on counting 2 feature regressions as defects)
exact_values_found: US RSS returned 53 written reviews; 27 dated 2021-01-01 or later (7 in 2021, 3 in 2022, 6 in 2023, 2 in 2024, 5 in 2025, 4 in 2026). Defects: 10 login/auth (2021-09-24, 10-30, 11-13, 11-14; 2022-12-10, 12-15, 12-22; 2023-01-27, 01-30, 11-03); crash 2023-04-01, 2023-09-21, 2026-10-08 x2; post-auth error 2021-10-13; parse error 2021-06-12; hang 2023-09-10; broken update 2025-03-28 = 18; plus feature regressions 2025-09-28 and 2026-10-23 = 20. No app published by Schwab Charitable/DAFgiving360 or Vanguard Charitable in US search results (Vanguard Group publishes only 'Vanguard' and 'Vanguard Events')
